policy: Company-team autonomous-driving technical reports selected from the five-track catalog. Require primary evidence of an official team report or company release; affiliations alone, individual/intern-led projects, sponsorships and backbone usage do not qualify. Do not infer internship or employment status. Dates are first arXiv submission dates, not media dates or revisions. Reuse catalog resource links and release status.

coverage.note: No attributable driving research paper was verified for this initial selection. Business announcements and unrelated papers named MOMENTA were excluded. This is not an exhaustive publication audit.

No attributable driving research paper was verified for this initial selection. General video models, model usage by other teams and business rumors were excluded. This is not evidence that the company has no driving research.
